questions.question: 3 pizzas are shared equally among 4 children. How much does each child get? Explain.
questions.expected_answer: Cut each pizza into 4 quarters, which makes 12 quarters. Each child gets 3 quarters, one from each pizza, so each child gets 3/4 of a pizza. 3 divided by 4 is 3/4.

questions.question: Write 23 divided by 4 as a mixed number.
questions.expected_answer: 4 goes into 23 five times, using 20, with 3 left over. The 3 left over is shared among 4, which is 3/4, so 23 divided by 4 is 5 and 3/4.

questions.question: How many quarter cups of flour are in 3 cups?
questions.expected_answer: Each cup holds 4 quarter cups, so 3 cups hold 3 times 4, which is 12 quarter cups.
